checks.decision: The existing ui_export_v1 profile contains neither plan nor workspace role. A verified sanitized-UI path is prohibited until readiness_ui_snapshot_v1 is reviewed. An explicit typed local operator or workspace-admin attestation remains Python-owned.
ui_export_v1 does not bind ChatGptClientSurface.WEB. No UI field may be relabeled as client identity.

A verified transport requires server_location, selected_transport, endpoint-origin and TLS-profile digests plus exactly one tunnel or public-endpoint receipt. No B1 sanitizer provides that contract. B2 must emit unknown until a separately approved transport lot supplies the typed summary.
metadata_document_v1 does not provide issuer, discovery, authorization-endpoint, token-endpoint and scope digests required by McpAuthenticationEvidenceSummary.
When persistent connectivity applies, this record must bind the exact same authentication summary as authentication_metadata and requires both advertised refresh capability and observed issuance.
ui_export_v1 app_state=draft|published|unknown is not the exact app_configured boolean and cannot prove the failed state.
ui_export_v1 access_control=public|restricted|unknown is not equivalent to workspace_app_access_granted and must not be reinterpreted.

tool_scan_snapshot_v1 uses capability/destructive/read-only/unknown counts up to 4096. The public summary requires tool_count, write_tool_count and high_risk_tool_count bounded to 1024. Destructive is not silently equivalent to high risk.

action_review_snapshot_v1 can supply the exact action-review digest. A verified record still requires the combined McpToolReviewEvidenceSummary, which cannot exist until the tool-review gap is closed.
The canonical local-policy projection and its sanitized commitment can bind both the record digest and bundle local_policy_sha256.
